0.name: Unlimited
0.description: Players have unlimited ammo, carry no ammo boxes and do not display an ammo count on the wrist.

1.name: Limited Generic
1.description: Players carry ammo boxes with a limited amount of ammo.
details: One box for each weapon class: Pistol, Submachine gun, Rifles/MGs, Shotgun, Sniper.
Mags and ammo boxes can be put on the chest of the player to consolidate ammo.
An ammo count is displayed on the wrist.

2.name: Limited Specific
2.description: Players carry ammo boxes with a limited amount of ammo.
details: Mags and ammo boxes can be put on the chest of the player to consolidate ammo.
An ammo count is displayed on the wrist.

3.name: Custom
3.description: Allows for full control over ammo by the map.

4.name: Limited Special
4.description: All weapons except special weapons are unlimited.

5.name: Boxless
5.description: Similar to Limited Generic but without boxes.
